description: Offline derived context from the fixed independently verified retained Census Nonemployer release.
retry: No automatic retry; re-run local transformation against the same fixed retained release.
checkpoint: Acquire means verify and reuse the fixed retained release offline. Immutable run and release directory; artifacts and manifest written before release directory is published.
cancellation: Cooperative AbortSignal checks during source verification, streaming, and before release publication.
idempotency: Each build has a new immutable run id; no current pointer is created or modified.
retention_profile: Versioned derived aggregate context retains source hashes, release identity, reference year, exact 2022 NAICS selection and measure flags.
